value.rationale: The exact optimum reconfiguration landscape of Turan extremizers is a natural invariant not determined by the extremal edge count: below the first possible batch it is edgeless, and at that same batch size it becomes connected and has a fully classified regular degree. The quotient/remainder boundary causes a sharp nonmonotone mobility law, relevant concretely to maximum mutual-visibility sets of triangular graphs. The calculation is an unbounded structural classification, not a routine one-off finite count.
